overall: MARGINAL overall: easy this afternoon and tonight, then wind-limited in the west Wednesday
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current at this evening's pickup in the south, then wind in the west from about 2 AM Wed. Wind now is 1.2–9 kt (gusts 4–14): Nangalao 9, Barangonan 8.4, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 7, and 1–5 kt elsewhere. Rain is minor: a brief shower around 2 PM on the Coron side (0.5 mm/h at Coron, Culion and Galoc), light showers about midnight–3 AM Wed in the west (up to 0.4 mm/h), then on-and-off light rain Wed morning; 24h totals 0.6–3.9 mm. The current stays easy until about 4 PM, picks up about 5–10 PM (peak 7–8 PM), goes slack about 11 PM–5 AM Wed , then picks up again about 7–10 AM Wed.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still references the Tropical Cyclone Alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) , not covering Palawan. The latest items (to Mon 26 Oct 5:26 AM PHT) are final general flood advisories for the Visayas regions, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Wednesday got windier in the west, so Thursday's supply now looks SOFT (was "slightly soft") and the mid-week dip starts a day earlier. ECMWF now holds 17–20 kt from about 3 AM through 1 PM Wed at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (this morning it showed 13–18 kt only before dawn), and Linapacan builds to 12–15 kt from 7 AM. Today and Wednesday arrivals stay normal.

Right now the grounds read 7 GOOD / 9 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 7 / 6 / 3 / 0 at the 6 AM pickup) in the easy midday current. Week shifts: Wed 28 is 9.7 kt, gusts 17, with 1.0 mm light rain (was dry). Thu 29 stays the hardest (14 kt, gusts 20, 1.1 mm). Fri 30 is calmer (6.2 kt, gusts 12; was gusts 18). Sat 31 is drier (1.4 mm; was 4.6) and still GOOD. Sun 1 is breezier and wetter (13 kt, gusts 17, 4.8 mm). Mon 2 stays GOOD. PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.

The tightening now runs Thu 29–Fri 30 , a day earlier on the west-side grounds. Buy ahead today and Wednesday morning; lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for Thursday.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 4 PM, then tonight 11 PM–1 AM (sheltered grounds until about 5 AM)
details: Now–4 PM: Decabobo, Panlaitan, Linapacan, Galoc and Maglalambay 0.1–0.3 kt, Culion 0.2–0.4, wind 1–5 kt; the Coron-side shower clears after 2 PM. This is the calmest daytime window of the week.

11 PM–1 AM tonight: slack at Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Alava and Binudac (0.0–0.2), wind about 1–5 kt. On the Coron side, Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Maglalambay and Panlaitan it stays slack-ish and calm until about 5 AM.
Keep small boats off Decabaitot, Turda, Tara and Alava during the 7–8 PM peak, and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan from about 2 AM Wed into Wednesday afternoon (16–20 kt).
